description: Get the current pool/spa status of one iAqualink system: air, pool and spa temperatures, heater set points, pumps, heaters (pool/spa/solar), freeze protection, aux circuits and lights (with names), and — where the system reports them — salt chlorinator output, boost, salinity, pH and ORP. Readings are cached for a few seconds to stay polite to iAqualink.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands; "raw" returns the upstream payload unprojected. compact = normalized status; full = plus aux/light details and the unprocessed entries; raw = iAqualink’s responses untouched.

name: iaqualink_get_status
